basis: THE SPLIT ONLY. Dmitry approved splitting PLAN-0019 W14 over Telegram on 2026-09-21 (message 28554, 'split'), answering an ask in 28553 that named the recommendation and its cost. The ask said VELDO-0029 as written was four items wearing one hat: the signed enrollment binding, local socket routing, the SSH relay, and what happens when the authority is unreachable; that each has its own set, its own falsifier and its own fixture; that together they are a ticket that never closes; and that splitting means PLAN-0019 goes to revision 2, which is a plan change and therefore his. It also said the first piece is the same under either answer, so that piece was being built while he decided. WHAT CHANGED: the plan is at revision 2; W14 keeps VELDO-0029 and narrows to the binding and the resolution that reads it; W84 VELDO-0107 (local authenticated IPC), W85 VELDO-0108 (the SSH command relay) and W86 VELDO-0109 (the unreachable authority) are new, each depending on the one before. WHAT THIS DOES NOT GRANT: it is not an approval to land any of the four. All four are DRAFT. Each needs its own ready transition and its own landing approval, and this record is not either of those for any of them. It also authorises no change to any other work item of PLAN-0019 and is not a standing grant to re-plan.
